_comment: P1 live-gated acceptance smoke for the aesir game. Pass `args` to the playtest_capture MCP tool against a live editor with L_Arena. GREEN => every subsequent PASS is trustworthy (frames captured, wave state reached, enemies spawned, no log errors, perf within band). To exercise the crash-diagnosis path, write a null-deref into AEnemyCharacter::Tick, rebuild, and re-run: the result must carry crash{kind,file,line,frames} + an error code instead of a bare transport error.

expect.montage: a filmstrip of the wave with the enemy count rising
expect.on_null_deref_in_Tick: verdict FAIL with crash={kind:'crash'|'assert', file:'.../EnemyCharacter.cpp', line:<n>, frames:[...]} and a machine-branchable code — no human reads the crash window
